user.title: Set up lawn
user.description: Select your existing OpenWeatherMap weather entity. The assistant only gives recommendations and does not control irrigation.

data.name: Name
data.initial_gts: Current grassland temperature sum (0 for automatic start)

data_description.initial_gts: If installing during the year, enter a known starting value here. From the next January 1, the integration starts automatically at 0.
data_description.temperature_entity: This sensor has priority. If it is not selected or is unavailable, the current OpenWeatherMap temperature is used automatically.
data_description.mowed_entity: An off-to-on transition records mowing and acknowledges the mowing season. Without a selection, use the manual button.
data_description.watered_entity: An off-to-on transition records watering and updates the soil model. Without a selection, use the manual button.
data_description.precipitation_entity: Accepts precipitation depth or precipitation intensity. Without a sensor, no rain is added to the soil model; forecasts are used only for recommendations.
data_description.precipitation_mode: Automatic uses the unit and state class. Select a fixed type if your sensor reports an ambiguous value in mm.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Gently calibrates the modeled soil reservoir toward the measured percentage every six hours. Without a sensor, the model continues independently.
data_description.soil_temperature_entity: When selected, soil temperature takes priority for vegetation-state decisions.
data_description.default_watering_amount: Amount added to the soil model when watering is recorded and no calculated recommendation is available.
data_description.initial_soil_moisture: Starting value of the virtual soil reservoir. For normal loamy soil, 70% is a reasonable initial estimate.
data_description.root_depth_cm: Effective depth of the active lawn root zone. Ten centimeters preserves the previous model behavior.
data_description.slope: A steeper surface reduces infiltration during intense rain.
data_description.compaction: Compacted soil accepts water more slowly and produces more runoff.
data_description.irrigation_efficiency: Fraction of applied irrigation that reaches the modeled root zone.
data_description.rain_correction: Corrects systematic over- or underestimation of the observed rain source. 1.0 leaves it unchanged.
data_description.soil_sensor_dry: Raw percentage shown by the physical sensor in dry soil.
data_description.soil_sensor_wet: Raw percentage shown by the physical sensor near field capacity. Must be greater than the dry reference.

temperature_unavailable.title: Outdoor temperature unavailable
temperature_unavailable.description: Neither the selected outdoor sensor nor the OpenWeatherMap weather entity currently provides a valid temperature. Check both entities.

forecast_unavailable.title: Weather forecast unavailable
forecast_unavailable.description: No daily or hourly forecast is currently available. Check the selected OpenWeatherMap entity and its configured mode.

configured_entity_unavailable.title: Configured input entity unavailable
configured_entity_unavailable.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` is missing, unknown, or unavailable. Correct the entity under Configure or restore it.

forecast_stale.title: Weather forecast is stale
forecast_stale.description: The last successful forecast update is more than three hours old. Check OpenWeatherMap and its API availability.

observed_precipitation_unavailable.title: Observed precipitation unavailable
observed_precipitation_unavailable.description: No usable observed precipitation sensor was found. Enable the OpenWeatherMap rain sensor or select a precipitation sensor in the integration options.

current_weather_stale.title: Current weather data is stale
current_weather_stale.description: The current OpenWeatherMap observations are more than three hours old. The water model is using a reduced fallback calculation until fresh humidity, wind, and cloud data are available.
